question: Find the display names of users who own posts that received a comment containing a URL (i.e., 'http://') and have a view count above the average view count of all posts. Among these owners, only include those whose reputation exceeds 1000.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
JOIN posts AS p ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
JOIN comments AS c ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
WHERE c."XCL_008" LIKE '%http://%'
  AND p."XCL_030" > (SELECT AVG("XCL_030") FROM posts)
  AND u."XCL_053" > 1000
